_comment: exact = whole-string overrides; terms = names protected/translated inside sentences (whole words; single words are case-sensitive, terms of two or more words also match all lower case or with only the first letter capitalized). Policy: GW2 proper names, boons, conditions and crafting materials stay in English; only names with an established Italian form are translated. patterns = whole-line rules for item names, {X} = the prefix words (e.g. "{X} Longbow": "Arco lungo {X}"). feminine = role names (Italian masculine) and their feminine: a name alone such as "Cittadino" becomes Cittadino[f:"Cittadina"] and the game shows the feminine on women NPCs.

advice.ascended: The adjective "ascended" (an item rarity) is translated with "asceso", agreeing in gender and number with its noun and written without quotes, like any adjective: "ascended armor" = "armatura ascesa", "ascended weapons" = "armi ascese", "ascended rings" = "anelli ascesi". Never "ascendente", "potenziato", "superiore" or "di livello".
advice.Focus: "Focus" as an item is the off-hand weapon: keep it as "Focus" (plural "Focus"), never "Concentrazione", "Fulcro" or "Punto focale" ("focus skills" = "abilità del Focus"). As a verb ("focus on", "focus your energy") translate it normally ("concentrati", "concentrare").
advice.staff: "Staff" as a weapon is "staffa" (feminine: "la staffa", "una staffa", plural "staffe"), never "bastone", "rigo" or "staff". When "staff" means the people who work somewhere, translate it as "personale".
advice.glider: "Glider" (the equipment used for gliding) is "aliante", plural "alianti", never "deltaplano".
advice.sunspear: "Sunspear" (singular, also as an adjective) refers to the Sunspears faction, "le Lance del Sole": "Sunspear Recruit" = "Recluta delle Lance del Sole". The event name "Sunspear Uprising" stays in English.
advice.separatist: "Separatist" (one member of the Separatists faction) = "separatista"; as an adjective use "dei Separatisti" ("Separatist Engineer" = "Ingegnere dei Separatisti").
advice.purist: "Purist" (one member of the Purists faction) = "purista"; as an adjective use "dei Puristi".
advice.corsair: "Corsair" (one member of the Corsairs) = "corsaro", plural "corsari"; as an adjective use "dei Corsari".
advice.forgotten: "the Forgotten" (the ancient serpent-like race) = "i Dimenticati"; "a Forgotten" = "un Dimenticato". In other meanings "forgotten" is just "dimenticato".
advice.seer: "Seer" as one of the ancient Seers = "Veggente" (plural "Veggenti").
advice.dwarf: "Dwarf" = "nano" (the dwarves of Tyria, plural "i Nani"); "the Great Dwarf" = "il Grande Nano".
advice.skin: "Skin" of an item (weapon, armor, back item, glider, mount, wardrobe) stays "skin" in Italian: a feminine loanword, invariable in the plural ("la skin", "le skin", "skin uniche"). In item names the skin comes first, then the object named in the English name, with the article: "Tempest Torch Skin" = "Skin della torcia della Tempesta", "Hawk Wings Backpack Skin" = "Skin dell'accessorio dorsale Ali di falco". Translate only the object that the English name contains, never add a weapon or an armor piece that is not there: when the name has no object word, write "Skin di" and the name ("Zenith Kris Skin" = "Skin di Zenith Kris"). "weapon skins" = "skin delle armi", "armor skins" = "skin delle armature", "This will unlock the skin in your wardrobe" = "Sbloccherà la skin nel tuo guardaroba". Never "pelle" or "variante" for a cosmetic skin. Only when it is the skin of a body (a person, an animal, a creature) translate "skin" as "pelle": "your skin burns" = "la tua pelle brucia"; to skin an animal = "scuoiare".
advice.backpack: A back item (backpack, backpiece, cape, wings: anything worn on the back) is always "accessorio dorsale" in Italian, masculine, plural "accessori dorsali"; never "zaino", "borsa", "corpetto" or "oggetto di supporto". In item names "accessorio dorsale" comes first and the rest of the name follows it: "Mursaat Wings Backpack" = "Accessorio dorsale Ali di Mursaat", "Legendary Backpacks" = "Accessori dorsali leggendari", "Xera's Backpiece" = "Accessorio dorsale di Xera", "King Toad Backpack Cover" = "Copertura per accessorio dorsale Re Rospo", "Unequip this backpack" = "Rimuovi questo accessorio dorsale", "the ascended backpack Upper Bound" = "l'accessorio dorsale asceso Upper Bound".
